# Nick Scavio

> Attorney, Investor, General Counsel

Nicholas J. Scavio is a Phoenix, Arizona-based attorney with over 15 years of experience in legal strategy across real estate, venture, and corporate law. He founded Scavio Law Firm in 2022 and serves as General Counsel for Common Ground and LIEF Development + Construction.

## Practice Areas

- Cannabis Industry Law: licensing, compliance, corporate governance, M&A, regulatory strategy
- Construction Law: contract negotiation, lien rights, dispute resolution, project counsel
- Commercial Real Estate: acquisition, development, sale, leasing, multi-property transactions
- Business & Corporate Law: entity formation, corporate structuring, governance, strategic counseling
- Commercial Litigation: dispute resolution across Arizona, California, Colorado, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Oregon, Texas, and Washington
- Contract Drafting & Negotiation: vendor agreements, service contracts, NDAs

## Credentials

- Juris Doctor, Sandra Day O'Connor College of Law, Arizona State University (2010)
- B.I.S. in Business Administration & Mass Communication, Arizona State University (2006)
- State Bar of Arizona
- U.S. District Court (D. Ariz.)
- Southwest Super Lawyers Rising Star (2016 to 2024)
- Over $100M in transactions closed
- Litigated cases in 8 states

## Current Ventures

- Scavio Law Firm (Founder)
- Common Ground (General Counsel): venture advisory and strategic partnerships for founders and operators
- LIEF Development + Construction (Investor & General Counsel): design-forward development
- Drive For The Dream (General Counsel): story-led media project
- APEXX AI (General Counsel): practical AI systems
